scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/security packages/db packages/ssh packages/docker packages/ollama apps/api && npm run build --workspace @orc/web
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/security/test/*.test.mjs packages/docker/test/*.test.mjs packages/db/test/*.test.mjs apps/api/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @orc/web
